title: Variant Traffic Journey: Guided Handoff Mockups & Screenshot Fixtures
creator: Avery Chen
description: Create a set of high-fidelity onboarding and quickstart visual assets for the Rollouts surface that developers and PMs can use in release notes, Console docs, and in-product guided handoffs. Focus on variant traffic visualization (canary, A/B, fallback), step-by-step microcopy for first-time users, screenshot fixtures for engineering documentation, and a developer-friendly asset package (redlines, export presets, and telemetry hooks).
decisions: Primary visualization will use a compact horizontal flow with weighted bars (+ numeric percent) to represent variant traffic rather than pie charts to conserve vertical space in Console panels.
Use three canonical states: Canary (5-20% weighting), A/B (split 50/50 or configurable), Fallback policy (primary -> fallback routing with timeouts/latency thresholds).
Export presets standardized to 1440x720 PNG for docs, 1200x628 JPEG for marketing, and 720x360 GIFs for step recordings.
Microcopy tone: direct, developer-focused, short actionable lines with a single CTA per screen (e.g., "Pin version", "Start canary", "Set fallback policy").
acceptance_criteria: Figma frames include set of 6 annotated screens covering: initial pin, create canary, monitoring overlay, A/B split editor, fallback policy editor, and success confirmation.
Each frame has export-ready overlays showing callouts for telemetry metrics: request rate, p50/p95 latency, error rate, and variant weight.
Design tokens and CSS snippets supplied for front-end engineering (colors, spacing, typography, iconography).
Accessibility checks passed for color contrast on weighted bars and status badges (contrast ratio >= 4.5:1).
Developer handoff package uploaded to Drive with a README that lists screenshots, GIFs, and code snippets for embedding in docs.
review_feedback: PM: Add a microcopy variant that calls out cost impact when enabling canary on heavy-traffic routes.
Eng: Provide a lightweight mock JSON payload that matches Console state for screenshot fixtures so E2E tests can render deterministic images.
Security: Ensure no real customer IDs appear in screenshots and provide a sanitized dataset for monitoring panels.
qa_checklist: Export each frame in three sizes and verify pixel-perfect alignment versus templates.
Validate GIF step recordings at 15fps and <2MB size target for docs site.
Cross-check microcopy against localization CSV to ensure tokenization-friendly strings.
Confirm telemetry labels used in visuals match ENG instrumentation names (see dependency ENG-84211).
mockups: Onboarding hero: 1 screen showing end-to-end quickstart with a single CTA 'Create a canary' and a condensed explainer column.
Canary editor: Weighted slider plus input, preset buttons (5%, 10%, 20%), and inline metric preview.
A/B split editor: Comparative cards for two variants with sample prompt + output snapshots and traffic split control.
Fallback policy editor: Flow diagram for primary -> fallback with triggers (timeout, errors, latency) and preview toggle.
Monitoring overlay: Compact charts (request rate sparkline, p50/p95 bars, error badge) and a variant weight history timeline.
Success toast + release summary: Small modal summarizing rollout start parameters and a deep-link to the rollout dashboard.
screenshot_specs: Docs PNG: 1440x720, 1x export, 72dpi, include annotation layer in an adjacent file.
Marketing JPEG: 1200x628, high quality, flattened with background gradient.
In-product thumbnails: 600x300, optimized for lazy-loading via next-gen formats (webp).
GIF: 720x360, 15fps, loop=1, max duration 6s, overlay cursor highlight for step focus.
accessibility_notes: Ensure all interactive elements in screenshots show keyboard focus state for a11y documentation.
Use patterned fills (diagonals) for weighted bars when contrast alone is insufficient for color-blind users.
Provide alt-text drafts for each exported image in the handoff README.
localization_notes: Keep microcopy under 60 characters for hero CTAs to avoid truncation in non-latin scripts.
Mark strings for translation using {{rollout_action}} tokens to allow injection at runtime.
Supply a CSV with context columns: key, english, description, max_length.
handoff_instructions: Upload final assets to Drive folder and mark file versions with semantic tag 'ready-for-engineering'.
Include a small 'render fixture' JSON (mock_state.json) that maps to Console React props for ENG to use in snapshot tests.
Provide CSS variables and token mapping in a single file: tokens/rollouts-tokens.css.
Schedule a 30-minute handoff meeting with Eng and PM; record and attach meeting notes to Confluence.
